IM=Bekijk|O=de naam van het actieve netwerk.
Look at the name of the active network.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Ask for inspection of the active network's name.
Bekijk is the imperative stem. De naam van het actieve netwerk is the object to inspect, not an instruction to change the active network.
Is the correct output folder in the field?
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Check the output-folder field.
Staat begins the yes/no question with subject de juiste uitvoermap. In het veld locates the displayed folder path.
The brightness is set to the lowest level.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Describe the current brightness value.
Staat describes a setting, with op de laagste stand as its selected level. Laagste is the superlative of laag.
Can we compare the values with the manual?
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Suggest comparing settings with the manual.
Kunnen takes bare infinitive vergelijken. Met de handleiding means comparing the displayed values against those specified in the manual.
Note the number next to the device name.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Ask for the number beside the device name.
Noteer is an imperative. Naast de apparaatnaam identifies which number is needed, rather than asking for a security code.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Report the current power-saving state.
Is takes adjective actief for the current state. Niet denies active power saving, without saying the feature is unavailable.
This option only applies to new documents.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Limit the setting's scope to new documents.
Geldt retains the stem-final d before added t. Alleen voor nieuwe documenten limits the setting to new documents, not existing ones.
Which value do you see for the scaling setting?
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Ask for the displayed scaling value.
Welke waarde is the question object. Zie precedes informal subject je; bij de schaalinstelling identifies the relevant control.
I have not restored the defaults yet.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Make clear that restoration has not happened.
Heb hersteld is perfect with no extra ge- after her-. Nog niet denies restoration so far, not an inability to restore later.
Close the settings window without changes.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Ask the colleague to exit without changing values.
Sluit is an imperative retaining its stem-final t. Zonder wijzigingen asks for closing without making changes to values.
S=We|V=controleren|G=of beide apparaten dezelfde tijdzone gebruiken.
We check whether both devices use the same time zone.
You are guiding a colleague through a diagnostic check, describing the next observation rather than promising a fix. Describe a comparison of both time-zone settings.
Of introduces whether and ends in plural gebruiken with beide apparaten. Dezelfde tijdzone is the shared value being checked.
The setting is visible, but not editable.
A setting can be viewed but cannot be edited in this situation. Describe that contrast without guessing its cause.
Zichtbaar and bewerkbaar are adjective complements after is. Maar niet contrasts seeing a setting with being able to edit it; this alone does not establish the cause.
Repeat the action once with the same file.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Ask for a single repeat with unchanged input.
Herhaal is an imperative. Eén keer requests a single repetition, while met hetzelfde bestand keeps the input unchanged.
What happens after the second click?
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Ask about the result of the second click.
Wat is the singular question subject of gebeurt. Na de tweede klik asks about the next event, not a proven cause.
The error code appears only with this sequence.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Report a sequence-specific failure.
Alleen limits the appearance to deze volgorde. Bij names the sequence condition, not a physical location.
I have noted down all the steps.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Confirm that every step has been recorded.
Heb genoteerd is perfect. Allemaal refers to all de stappen and is not a time expression.
We can repeat the test tomorrow under the same conditions.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Suggest a repeat under unchanged conditions tomorrow.
Kunnen takes bare infinitive herhalen. Morgen gives the repeat time and onder dezelfde omstandigheden keeps the conditions matched.
This attempt does not prove the cause.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Limit what can be concluded from the attempt.
Bewijst agrees with deze poging. Niet limits what this attempt establishes; it does not say the proposed cause has been disproved.
IM=Wacht|G=tot het document volledig geladen is.
Wait until the document has fully loaded.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Ask the colleague to wait before continuing.
Wacht is an imperative retaining stem-final t. Tot introduces an until-clause ending in geladen is; wait for loading to finish before continuing.
Do you get the same result without a connected printer?
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Check the result with the printer disconnected.
Krijg precedes informal je without added -t. Zonder aangesloten printer changes the test condition while asking whether the result stays the same.
On my first attempt, the message did not appear.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Describe the first attempt's different result.
Bij mijn eerste poging is fronted before past verscheen. De melding is the singular subject; niet denies its appearance on that first attempt.
The small test file does open normally.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Contrast the test file with the failing file.
Opent is singular with het kleine testbestand. Wel contrasts normal opening of the test file with the failing file already discussed.
S=Ik|V=noteer|G=welke stappen nodig zijn om de fout te herhalen.
I note which steps are needed to reproduce the error.
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Describe recording the required reproduction steps.
Welke stappen is an embedded plural subject with nodig zijn. Om de fout te herhalen gives the purpose for which those steps are required.
Is the sequence important for this error?
You are investigating a reproducible workplace fault with a colleague, asking for the exact sequence and conditions. Ask whether the sequence matters.
Is precedes subject de volgorde. Belangrijk voor deze fout asks about sequence relevance, without already claiming it matters.
IM=Maak|O=eerst een kopie van het testbestand.
Make a copy of the test file first.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Instruct the user to preserve a test copy.
Maak is an imperative. Eerst puts making a copy before later changes; van het testbestand identifies what to copy.
Can we schedule a short interruption now?
During planning, ask whether you can now schedule a brief interruption for a diagnostic check.
Kunnen takes infinitive plannen. Nu concerns arranging a short interruption at this planning stage, rather than claiming one has already occurred.
Leave the device connected during this check.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Specify that the connection must remain in place.
Laat is an imperative with het apparaat as object and aangesloten as the state to maintain during the check.
This step does not affect your saved documents.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Explain the limited scope of this step.
Raakt agrees with deze stap. Niet denies an effect on the saved documents in this step, not every possible operation.
Before you continue, you check the backup.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Describe the backup check before continuing.

Voordat introduces the before-clause ending in joined verdergaat. Main controleer je follows it, without added -t after informal je; this is a procedural statement, not an unspoken-subject imperative.
Note the current setting before the change.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Ask for a record of the value before changing it.
Noteer is an imperative. Voor de wijziging means before the change here, so the recorded value is the current one.
I do not want to interrupt your work unnecessarily.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Explain why you seek a suitable moment.
Wil takes bare infinitive onderbreken. Niet onnodig avoids unnecessary interruption, without rejecting every possible interruption.
IM=Wacht|PP=met de herstart|T=tot na de vergadering.
Wait until after the meeting to restart.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Postpone the restart until the meeting ends.
Wacht met names the action deferred. Tot na de vergadering sets the restart after the meeting, not during it.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Check that changes have been saved before continuing.
Heb precedes informal je in the perfect question; opgeslagen is the participle of opslaan. Alle wijzigingen asks whether every change was saved.
The check does not require a new installation.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Clarify that no installation is needed.
Vereist agrees with de controle. Geen nieuwe installatie denies an installation requirement for this check, without banning installation in other contexts.
Close only the empty test window.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. Limit closure to the empty test window.
Sluit is an imperative. Alleen het lege testvenster limits closure to that one empty window.
I wait until you give permission.
You are giving careful diagnostic instructions to a colleague and checking consent before actions that interrupt work. State you wait for the formally addressed user's permission.
Tot introduces an until-clause with formal u and final geeft. Wacht reports waiting for permission rather than assuming it has already been given.
S=De reactietijd|V=is|C=twee keer zo lang|C=als gisteren.
The response time is twice as long as yesterday.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Quantify the response-time comparison.
Twee keer zo lang ... als expresses twice the duration. Als gisteren supplies the comparison; this is not twice as fast.
The difference lies in the selected folder.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Identify the differing folder choice.
Zit describes a figurative location of the difference. In de gekozen map identifies the differing folder choice, not physical posture.
Which browser does the other colleague use?
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Ask which browser the comparison colleague uses.
Welke browser is the question object and de andere collega the singular subject of gebruikt. The question asks which browser that colleague uses.
I have selected the same settings on both devices.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Confirm matched settings.
Heb gekozen is perfect with irregular gekozen. Dezelfde instellingen are the matched settings selected on both devices, not a claim that all other conditions match.
The error text is not exactly the same.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Report a difference in wording.
Niet precies limits sameness: the texts are not exactly identical. Dezelfde stands for de fouttekst already understood.
For the second user, the warning is absent.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Describe the second user's different display.
Bij de tweede gebruiker is fronted before ontbreekt de waarschuwing. The warning is the singular subject and is absent for that second user.
We also need to compare the times.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Add timestamps to the comparison.
Moeten takes bare infinitive vergelijken. Ook adds the timestamps to other items already being compared.
Is the file size the same on both devices?
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Check whether the input sizes match.
Is begins the yes/no question with subject de bestandsgrootte. Op beide toestellen gives the two locations for checking equality.
The test environment uses an older version.
The test environment uses an older version than your normal workplace environment. Identify that difference to your colleague.
Gebruikt agrees with de testomgeving. Een oudere versie is comparative: an older version than the other environment in this scenario.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Say you record persistent differences.
Welke verschillen is the embedded plural subject of blijven bestaan. Both verb forms make the final cluster for differences that continue to exist.
The wired connection was more stable.
Earlier tests showed that the wired connection was more stable than the wireless connection. Report that comparison.
Was is singular past with de bekabelde verbinding. Stabieler compares the wired connection with the wireless one in this scenario.
A difference is not automatically the cause.
You are comparing diagnostic observations across devices and sessions, describing differences without assuming their cause. Avoid treating any difference as proof of causation.
De oorzaak is a complement after is. Niet automatisch denies that any observed difference by itself proves causation.
There are still two possible causes.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Report the remaining number of hypotheses.
Er introduces the remaining possibilities. Twee mogelijke oorzaken is plural with zijn; nog counts hypotheses still under consideration.
The error may be related to the settings.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Suggest a possible settings connection.
Kan expresses possibility and takes joined infinitive samenhangen. Met de instellingen names the possible relation, not an established diagnosis.
We check whether the disk is full.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. State the next storage-related hypothesis check.
Of introduces whether and ends in is. Vol is an adjective describing disk capacity; checking it does not assert the disk is full.
The log file does not yet give a conclusive answer.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Qualify inconclusive log evidence.
Nog geen sluitend antwoord means no conclusive answer yet. The log may contain evidence without settling the question.
We have ruled out a faulty cable.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Report a cause already ruled out.
Hebben uitgesloten is perfect of separable uitsluiten. Een defecte kabel is a cause already ruled out, not one still asserted as possible.
What do you base that suspicion on?
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Ask what supports the suspicion.
Waarop combines waar and op for the basis of the suspicion. Baseer precedes informal je; dat vermoeden is the object being supported.
The message points to a possible permissions problem.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Describe a clue without presenting certainty.
Wijzen op means point to or indicate. Mogelijk limits the permissions issue to a possible explanation, rather than proof.
Although the test succeeds, the cause remains unclear.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Explain that a passed test does not explain the cause.
Hoewel introduces a concession and ends in slaagt. Main blijft de oorzaak onduidelijk follows it; a passed test has not clarified the cause.
We must check this assumption first.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Request verification before relying on an assumption.
Moeten takes bare infinitive controleren. Eerst puts verification before relying on deze aanname, the assumption.
That is a possibility, not an established cause.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Distinguish a possibility from an established cause.
Een mogelijkheid and geen vastgestelde oorzaak are noun complements after is. The contrast withholds confirmation, without proving the possibility false.
The additional test has not confirmed our suspicion.
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Report a hypothesis not confirmed by testing.
Heeft bevestigd is perfect. Niet denies confirmation from the additional test, without automatically disproving the suspicion.
What information is missing so we can proceed?
You are narrowing down possible causes of a workplace problem, distinguishing a hypothesis from an established explanation. Ask what evidence is still needed.
Welke informatie is the singular question subject of ontbreekt. Om verder te kunnen gives the purpose of proceeding; te belongs before modal kunnen in this infinitive phrase.
We will discuss the observations this afternoon.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Announce the afternoon review.
Zullen takes bare infinitive bespreken. Vanmiddag locates the promised discussion this afternoon; it does not report completed review.
IM=Stuur|O=alleen de relevante regels uit het logbestand.
Send only the relevant lines from the log file.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Limit the requested log extract.
Stuur is an imperative. Alleen de relevante regels limits the requested log extract to relevant lines.
I can explain the result after the check.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Offer an explanation once the check finishes.
Kan takes joined infinitive toelichten. Na de controle puts the possible explanation after the check, not before its results exist.
S=We|V=hebben|T=nog|O=geen reden om gegevens te verwijderen.
We do not yet have a reason to delete data.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. State that deletion is not justified.
Nog geen reden denies a present justification. Om gegevens te verwijderen complements reden, naming the action needing justification.
S=De volgende stap|V=is|C=een controle van de vrije ruimte.
The next step is a check of the free space.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Name the next storage check.
Een controle van de vrije ruimte is a complement after is. The sentence identifies the next check, not an already-proven lack of space.
I note what we have already ruled out.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Describe keeping track of excluded causes.
Wat introduces an embedded object clause ending in hebben uitgesloten. Al marks causes already ruled out and noteer records them.
Can you keep track of the time during the test?
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Ask your colleague to time the test.
Kun takes joined infinitive bijhouden. Tijdens de test gives the timing period; de tijd is what the colleague should track.
We have prepared a test account for this check.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Report preparation of a test account.
Hebben klaargezet is perfect of klaarzetten. Voor deze controle gives purpose, not a deadline before it; the prepared item is a test account.
Ask for advice if the warning returns.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Give a condition for seeking advice.
Vraag is an imperative. Als introduces the condition ending in terugkomt; the return of the warning is conditional, not predicted.
S=Ik|V=houd|O=de gebruiker|C=op de hoogte van de controle.
I keep the user informed about the check.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Describe keeping the user informed.
Houd takes direct object de gebruiker and the state phrase op de hoogte. Van de controle names the topic; this means keeping the person informed.
We discuss which conclusion the data allows.
You are explaining the next diagnostic step to a colleague, setting an observation or review point without promising success. Describe reviewing what the evidence supports.
Welke conclusie is the embedded object and de gegevens the plural subject of toelaten. The team discusses what the evidence permits, not a predetermined diagnosis.
I am investigating the error step by step.
You are explaining your current diagnostic work to a colleague. Say that you are investigating the error step by step, without claiming a completed diagnosis.

Bezig plus te onderzoeken describes the action currently in progress. De fout is the object before the infinitive. Compare bezig met het onderzoek, where met takes an activity noun, and aan het onderzoeken, another ongoing-action construction.
